skills.name: Sugar Intake
skills.description: Eats favorite foods. Good effects on allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (5 sec) *HP +500% (10 sec) *Move Speed +180% (10 sec)

skills.name: Some kind of wave!
skills.description: Releases energy beams from both hands. Bad effects on enemies.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (6 sec) *ATK x 4000% Area Damage  *Stuns enemies (6 sec)

abilities.name: Group: GINTAMA
abilities.description: GINTAMA Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Enemy Cost Increase2
abilities.description: Gives a set chance of greatly increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed.  This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
